import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { authAPI } from '../services/api'; const Login = () => { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [username, setUsername] = useState(''); const [password, setPassword] = useState(''); const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState(null); const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); setLoading(true); setError(null); try { const response = await authAPI.login(username, password); localStorage.setItem('token', response.data.access_token); navigate('/'); } catch (err) { setError(err.response?.data?.detail || err.message || 'Invalid credentials'); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; return (
